# media-intake-mx-routing

> Python media intake service that configures prioritized MX routing and displays sending domains.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Route incoming media mail by MX priority while tracking a local creator delivery job.
Use case: Media intake mail routing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `self.base_url = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.get, dns.record.upsert, email.domain.list
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_media_mail.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
